newsHighlights.title: China's AI user base surges, generative AI industry expands
newsHighlights.summary: The number of generative artificial intelligence users in China has exceeded 700 million as of June, up from 602 million at the end of last year.
newsHighlights.translation: 截至今年6月，中国生成式人工智能用户数已超过7亿，较去年年底的6.02亿大幅增长。

newsHighlights.title: Innovation drives agri-growth
newsHighlights.summary: Scientific innovation and digital technology are driving agricultural growth, raising productivity and creating new opportunities for rural communities.
newsHighlights.translation: 科技创新与数字技术正推动农业增长，提高生产力，并为农村社区创造新机遇。

newsHighlights.title: Smartphone 'detox' a refresh for peace of mind
newsHighlights.summary: More young people are trying a smartphone 'detox' by turning off notifications and setting screen-free hours to protect their mental health.
newsHighlights.translation: 越来越多的年轻人尝试智能手机“戒断”，通过关闭通知、设定无屏幕时段来守护心理健康。

newsHighlights.title: Xi Jinping urges Sichuan University to serve national strategies
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping urged Sichuan University to better serve national strategies and strengthen scientific research and talent cultivation.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席勉励四川大学更好服务国家战略，加强科学研究与人才培养。

quote.quote: The advance of technology is based on making it fit in so that you don't really even notice it, so it's part of everyday life.
quote.author: Bill Gates
quote.translation: 科技的进步在于让它融入生活，让你几乎察觉不到它的存在，从而成为日常生活的一部分。
quote.explanation: 技术的最高境界不是炫目，而是无形。当人工智能像水电一样自然地服务我们的学习、农业和医疗时，它才真正创造了价值；这也是今天我们讨论AI普及与“手机戒断”时的重要启示。

vocabulary.example: China's AI user base has surged over the past year.
vocabulary.translation: 过去一年，中国的AI用户数激增。
vocabulary.newsContext: 新闻标题：China's AI user base surges, generative AI industry expands.

vocabulary.definition: 超过；超出（数量、程度或限制）
vocabulary.example: The number of generative AI users in China has exceeded 700 million.
vocabulary.translation: 中国生成式人工智能用户数已超过7亿。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自摘要："The number of generative artificial intelligence users in China has exceeded 700 million as of June."

vocabulary.example: The generative AI industry is expanding rapidly in China.
vocabulary.translation: 中国的生成式人工智能产业正在快速扩张。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题与摘要："generative AI industry expands"。

vocabulary.example: The rapid expansion of AI applications benefits many industries.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能应用的快速扩展惠及众多行业。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题："generative AI industry expands"（expand 的名词形式）。

vocabulary.example: Innovation drives agricultural growth and raises productivity.
vocabulary.translation: 创新驱动农业增长并提高生产力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题："Innovation drives agri-growth"。

vocabulary.example: Digital tools help farmers improve productivity in the fields.
vocabulary.translation: 数字工具帮助农民提高田间生产效率。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻："Innovation drives agri-growth"，科技创新提升农业生产率。

vocabulary.example: Chinese universities are encouraged to make breakthroughs that serve national strategies.
vocabulary.translation: 中国高校被鼓励取得服务国家战略的突破性成果。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻："Xi Jinping urges Sichuan University to serve national strategies"，强调科研突破与人才培养。

vocabulary.example: AI applications now cover farming, healthcare and education.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能应用现已覆盖农业、医疗和教育领域。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻：AI用户突破7亿，生成式AI应用不断拓展至各行业。

vocabulary.definition: （对电子产品的）戒断、排毒；进行戒断
vocabulary.example: Many young people are trying a smartphone detox for peace of mind.
vocabulary.translation: 许多年轻人正尝试戒断手机，以求内心安宁。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题："Smartphone 'detox' a refresh for peace of mind"。

vocabulary.example: Balancing development and security strengthens the country's technological resilience.
vocabulary.translation: 统筹发展与安全能增强国家的科技韧性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联新闻："Xi calls for balancing nation's development, security"，强调发展与安全并重。

pattern.pattern: as of + 时间点, ... has/have + past participle ... , (up/representing) ... from ...
pattern.example: As of June, the number of generative AI users in China has exceeded 700 million, up from 602 million at the end of last year.
pattern.translation: 截至6月，中国生成式人工智能用户数已超过7亿，高于去年年底的6.02亿。
pattern.usage: 用于描述数据统计的时间节点与变化幅度。“as of + 时间”表示“截至……时”，主句常用现在完成时强调“到现在为止”的结果；后接 up from / a rise from / compared with 引出对比数据，是英文经济与科技新闻中最常见的数据表达框架。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻英语中的运用
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）表示过去发生、但对现在仍有影响或持续到现在的动作或状态。科技与经济新闻常用它来报道“最新统计数据”“阶段性成果”，常与 already, yet, so far, as of + 时间, over the past year 等时间状语连用。注意：当句中有明确的过去时间点（如 last year, in 2025）时，改用一般过去时。
examples: The number of generative artificial intelligence users in China has exceeded 700 million as of June.
This represents a significant rise from 602 million users at the end of last year.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 -fi- 上，读作 ar-ti-FI-cial；第一个音节轻读为 /ɑːr/，第三个音节 /ˈfɪʃ/ 要读得饱满有力，词尾 -cial 发 /ʃl/，不是“西亚”。整词节奏为“弱—弱—强—弱”。注意与 artificial intelligence 连读时，/l/ 与后面的元音自然衔接：/ˌɑːrtɪˈfɪʃl ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns/。
examples: China's artificial intelligence user base has exceeded 700 million.
Generative artificial intelligence is changing the way we work and learn.

reading.title: China's Generative AI Boom: More Users, Wider Use
reading.content: China's generative artificial intelligence user base has exceeded 700 million as of June, according to a recent report, a significant rise from 602 million at the end of last year. The rapid expansion reflects both strong policy support and growing public enthusiasm for smart tools. AI applications are no longer limited to chatbots: they now help farmers monitor crops, doctors analyze medical images and teachers design lessons. In the countryside, innovation and digital technology have raised productivity and opened new markets for rural communities. At the same time, many young people are trying a smartphone "detox" — turning off notifications and setting screen-free hours — to protect their mental health. Experts say the key is to use technology mindfully. When people master tools instead of being controlled by them, AI becomes a real partner in daily life. Sustained investment in research, talent and safety rules will help the industry grow in a healthy and secure way.
reading.translation: 据最新报告，截至今年6月，中国生成式人工智能用户数已超过7亿，较去年年底的6.02亿大幅增长。这一快速扩张既反映了强有力的政策支持，也体现了公众对智能工具日益高涨的热情。人工智能应用已不再局限于聊天机器人：如今它帮助农民监测作物、帮助医生分析医学影像、帮助教师设计课程。在乡村，创新与数字技术提高了生产力，为农村社区开辟了新市场。与此同时，许多年轻人正尝试智能手机“戒断”——关闭通知、设定无屏幕时段——以保护心理健康。专家表示，关键在于有节制地使用技术。当人们驾驭工具而不是被工具控制时，人工智能才真正成为日常生活的伙伴。持续投入科研、人才培养与安全法规，将助力该行业健康、安全地发展。
reading.sourceNote: 基于 ChinaDaily《China's AI user base surges, generative AI industry expands》《Innovation drives agri-growth》《Smartphone 'detox' a refresh for peace of mind》及 CGTN 相关报道改写，用于英语学习，非原文转载。
